recentItems.title: Trump Melts Down Over AI Fears, Don Jr’s Shady Oligarch-Funded Wedding: A Closer Look Out of Office
recentItems.description:
Seth Meyers and A Closer Look supervising writer/producer Sal Gentile discuss the news stories they’re missing while Late Night is on hiatus. In this episode they discuss reports that Donald Trump Jr.'s wedding was partially funded by a Russian oligarch, Trump's decision to import "mystery meat," an AI researcher's warning that AI could lead to the extinction of humanity and Trump's promise of a $5,000 check after the midterms, which critics have called a “bribe."
